issue.title: Inbox routing for Ctrl+Shift+P and Ctrl+Shift+Enter
issue.description: On an open task that lives in an inbox note, every Ctrl+Shift+P Task Card commit and every Ctrl+Shift+Enter toggle first asks where the task goes. Nothing is written until a destination is chosen. The task then lands in its new home with the action applied, and a review-walk landing advances to the next item, so morning triage never needs a separate Ctrl+Shift+M.
